title: The Guardian of the Crepe Tree
paragraphs: That night, I made my way to the village where the Bio-Plants had been distributed via the portal. Of course, I was moving in stealth mode, having layered “Liberation Fire Mirage” over my Cloaking Lance. Sure enough, it looked like the villagers had been forced to evacuate due to the Bio-Plants’ corruption.

Oh well. I made my way through the evacuation center, spraying healing potions from my lance onto those suffering there, and treated everyone in the infested village. I’ve also unlocked the plant-based skill weapons that Father used to wield. After quickly spraying the potions here and there, I made my way right up to the base of the Bio-Plant…
“Liberation Firestorm X!”

I’ll burn it all to the ground in one go. Even so, the bio-plant stubbornly began to writhe, so I scattered the herbicide—Father’s special formula—that I’d prepared just in case, and eradicated it completely. Bio-plant seeds started falling down, one by one.

I collected everything that scattered and, without asking, replanted a safe, moderately modified bio-plant. I remember the mixing ratios for this area. After all, Father from the first world taught me how to easily procure food for the Filolials.
“Lords Filolial! It’s time to eat!”
Responding to my voice, the Lords Filolial came running from behind and began devouring the food left behind by the Bio-Plant.
“W-what’s going on!? The Lords Filolial!?”
“Wait, something’s off here…”
“W-what’s going on!?”
“Are you saying the legendary divine bird saved us?”
“The Filolials are eating the fruit the Spear Hero brought…”
“Can something like this really happen…? It’s truly a miracle of the divine bird!”
“It’s the divine bird!　It’s His Divine Majesty the Divine Bird!”
The villagers are making quite a commotion, but right now, it’s all about the Filolials.
“Well then, Filolials, let’s retreat from here.”
“Yeah!”
“Let’s go home!”
“Let’s go!”

With a thud-thud-thud and a cloud of dust, we left the scene. To make it look like Father had resolved the situation later on, I stayed hidden as much as possible as we left the scene. Well, retrieving the bio-plant was a breeze.
“Well then, Father, this solves our food problem in one fell swoop, doesn’t it?”
So, I provided Father with the bio-plant materials and seeds.
“Where on earth did you get these…? Well, I suppose it’s because you know the location thanks to your knowledge of the future.”
“Hahaha!”
“Stop laughing and answer me.”
“…Boo.”
“What? Is there a village having trouble with the plants Motoyasu scattered all over Melromarc?”

Father pointed at the bio-plant materials and the monsters, so I nodded. But you Lazy Pig—don’t say anything that’ll put me in a bad light. Of course, the bio-plants are one of the sins I’ve committed, but you have no right to condemn me for it.
“I treated the villagers as discreetly as possible, took care of the situation, and then had Lord Filolial and his men transport them.”
“Even if no one’s found out about that yet, don’t just go wandering around all over the place!”
“It’s fine!”
“Just stop going in and out of Melromarc so carelessly! Sigh… Well, I guess we’ll just have to figure things out as we go once this is all settled…”
In the end, Father planted the bio-plant in the garden of the house we were using as our base and had everyone tend to it.
“Now then, you lot! Those who don’t work shouldn’t eat. If you don’t get properly strong, you’ll never escape being exploited.”

After that, Father began subjecting the village slaves to a Spartan-style training regimen—one passed down directly from my Older Sister and Lady Filolial herself. As I watched that scene unfold… I headed over to Luna-chan. She’s with a pig that looks like Keel.
“So, Keel… why don’t you get stronger alongside Luna and learn how to transform?”
“Buh? B-b-b-b-b-buh!”
As Luna-chan lifted Keel up from behind, Keel reached out toward my older sister as if trying to call out to her for help.
“Uh… Luna, why are you getting so cozy with Keel-kun?”
“Hm? Because Kita told me it would make him cuter.”
“Bubububu!”
“Um… Keel-kun is a boy, you know? Shouldn’t he be getting cooler instead?”
Huh? It seems the Older Sister doesn’t know Keel’s secret. Well then, I suppose I’d better fill her in. Information should be shared, after all.
“Miss, Keel is a canine-therianthrope who transforms into a pig. Right now, he’s cursed and in the form of a pig.”
“A pig… Keel-kun, I have a bad feeling about this, so please come over here with Luna-chan for a moment.”
“Oink!? Oink-oink-oink! Oink-oink-oink-oink! Oinkyaaaah!”

Keel’s thrashing about for some reason, but the older sister and Luna-chan have taken him away. It seems he’s being examined in another room. After a while, the Older Sister came back looking flustered.
“Naofumi-sama! Keel-kun turned out to be a girl!”
“Is that so? Well, at that age… no, it’s hard to tell the difference in gender just by appearance, but…”
“The Spear Hero called him a pig, so I checked… Don’t you already kind of know, Naofumi-sama?”
“…Well, I suppose so. Let’s confirm it just to be sure.”
Father is coming over to me, looking rather interested. I wonder what this is about? It’s a little embarrassing that Father is taking an interest in me. I can’t help but blush.
“Don’t make that gross face! So, Motoyasu, are you confident you can spot a pig?”
“Of course I am! After all, there are plenty of pigs in this world.”
“So Elena was a pig, was she?”
“That’s right.”
“And you’re saying Keel is a pig now, too?”
“That’s right.”
……For some reason, Father leads me outside and points at Zeltoble’s shop. Then he points at a male merchant.
“What about that one?”
“That’s a human.”
Next, he points at a pig walking by with a basket on its head.
“What about that one?”
“That’s a pig.”
Then he pointed at a Demi-Human adventurer.
“What’s that?”
“That’s a Demi-Human.”
He pointed at a pig wearing a wizard-like outfit standing behind them.
“Is that one a pig?”
“Yes, it is.”
And then he pointed at the therianthrope walking at the front of the group. Come to think of it, Zeltoble is a melting pot of races, isn’t it?
“That’s a Therianthrope, isn’t it?”
And finally, I pointed at Lady Filolial. It’s Plum-chan, eating Bio-Plant fruit to her heart’s content.
“That’s Plum-chan, isn’t it?”
“Hmm… I get the general idea now. I’d always thought it was weird that they kept calling her a pig… I don’t know if it’s a bad connection, some kind of curse, or the price of the loop…”
“What do you mean?”
“No… so the reason we can’t communicate is because she’s a pig, right?”
“That’s right.”
“Do you know why I can communicate with Raphtalia and the others?”
My kind Father gave me advice about this during a previous loop. So I decided to say exactly what he told me.
“It’s because they’re related to Filo-tan!”
When I answered so bluntly, Father let out a deep sigh.
“Elena, make sure to feed Filo well and win her over. Otherwise, you won’t be able to communicate with Motoyasu anymore.”
“Boo…”
“Don’t act like it’s a hassle! And Filo, don’t run away when you hear Motoyasu’s name!”
“Boo!”
I get the feeling Father is trying to make me see what a Lazy Pig I am. I’m sorry, Father, but I don’t think that’s going to work.
“A pig is a pig. Even if you try to win over Filo-chan, I’ll still be able to smell that filthy pig stench a mile away!”
“Ugh, come on… This is such a hassle.”
“Naofumi-sama, you’re saying the exact same thing as Elena.”
“That’s true… Sigh.”
“Oh my—it’s already so lively this early in the morning.”

It’s getting livelier and livelier, but I feel like the house is starting to get a bit cramped. I think we need to secure a new base of operations quickly. Since we have no choice, perhaps we’ll rent the house of the bandits who dwell in the wilds of Zeltoble for Lady Filolial and the others.

And just like that, our life in Zeltoble got off to a smooth start. Father put his business acumen to work and, in no time at all, made a name for himself as a new kind of merchant within Zeltoble. Before we knew it, he’d even made friends with a merchant selling accessories—one who’d have Lady Filolial and the others approaching him with sparkling eyes. It seemed he’d also established a close relationship with the monster merchants. I don’t think it’s been that long since we arrived in Zeltoble, though. As for the problem that followed… well…
“You guys went hunting with Sadeena yesterday, right? Today’s our turn!”
“No way! It’s obviously our turn again today!”
“Oh my…”
The village slaves are showing intense enthusiasm for a hunting trip centered around the Older Sister. What on earth is going on here?
“Everyone, please stop fighting over Older Sister!”
“Stop saying that in a tone that makes it sound like you don’t even mean it.”
“Yes. It’s written all over your face that you’ve always wanted to say that, Sadeena.”
“Even as you say that, Raphtalia-chan, you’re the one who wants to go with Older Sister, aren’t you?”
“Ugh…”
“Booh…”

The reason there’s such a scramble over my Older Sister’s Older Sister is that when we go hunting to level up, the choice is between taking a nice ride on the backs of Filolial and the others, or hunting by the sea with my Older Sister’s Older Sister. Naturally, I’m all for the Filolials. Both mentally and in terms of how fast you level up, the Filolials are definitely the best.
“I hate the Filolials!”
“What exactly do you have against the Filolials!?”
“Of course I do! I’d die if I rode one of those things!”
“I understand how you might feel like you’re going to heaven from the Filolials’ unique ride, but that’s part of the fun!”
“Shut up, Spear Guy!”

By the way, a few days after leveling up, Keel overcame his pig curse and became a dog. As expected, having Older Sister around really speeds up the learning process. Still, he’s a dog with a sharp tongue as always. It’s a pretty harsh thing to say, especially when I’m going out of my way to praise Lord Filolial.
“Keel-kun, rub-rub.”

Seeing Keel like that, Luna took an instant liking to him, and she’s been doting on him every day with great satisfaction. Luna really does love Keel. I remember from my own memories how, back when the village had become peaceful, she used to bury Keel in the feathers on her chest. Only during the coldest part of winter would Keel stick just his face out from under Luna’s chest.
“Whoa! Let go! Luna! Stop rubbing your cheek against me!”
By the way, the reason Keel doesn’t call Luna by her first name is apparently because she joined our group first. Come to think of it, Luna-chan always joined the group after Keel did.

But… while Filo-tan seems to be the “Sakura-chan” type, why doesn’t Luna-chan stand out much in that regard? Is it some kind of innate quality? Come to think of it, there was even a time she was playfully teasing a Mole, calling it cute.

At most, the difference between this version of Luna-chan and the Luna-chans we’ve seen so far is… that, aside from the very first one, she didn’t seem to be having much fun. Even that gap is starting to close now that she’s seen Keel in his dog form. I’ll think about asking Father for advice next time.
“Call me Luna-chan… Keel-kun, you’re cute.”
“I’m not cute! I’m cool!”
“I love you, Keel-kun.”
“Whoa! S-someone, help me!”

Oh… Keel’s being hugged by Luna-chan and getting buried under her. Those days when Luna-chan looked a little unsatisfied are long gone. But… really, Luna-chan and Keel look so picture-perfect together.

Come to think of it, I remember there were people who swore allegiance to Keel in the same way as Filo-tan’s personal guard. In the world after the “Wave” ended, Filo-tan was active as an Idol all over the place, but Keel was competing against her as Rival. Luna-chan must have been one of the early members of the Keel faction. It’s a very faint memory, but I recall hearing about one of their meetings and it caused a bit of a stir.

If I recall correctly, the official topic was… “Who would be the best match for Keel?” I believe. I’ve heard there were quite a few factions within Keel’s personal guard regarding this. The reason this topic came up was quite memorable. Apparently, it all started with the idea that “Keel’s child would surely be cute too. So, what should we do?”

When Itsuki heard this story, he said, “If an Idol had a lover, the fans would probably get upset, but Keel’s fans are actually hoping she’ll find a lover. Is this just how things are perceived in another world?” Without missing a beat, Ren looked at me and the members of Filo-chan’s personal guard, shook his head, and said, “That’s specific to Keel, so you shouldn’t take it as a reference.” But what did he mean by that?
I got sidetracked there. Let’s talk about Keel’s potential spouses.

There were two candidates, weren’t there? Father and the Tiger Man. Apparently, it’s not just that having a child with Father would lend prestige—it also stems from the characteristics of past Shield Heroes, who, even as half-breeds, tend to inherit strong features of Demi-Humans and Therianthropes. In other words, if the child were with Father, their dog form would surely be the same… The faction that honestly believed there might be more Keels was the one pushing for Father. It’s a very rude faction.

Next, Torao’s faction… This faction was discussed simply based on the hope that a child resembling a tiger version of Keel might be born. While Keel’s affection for Torao was part of the reason, they were likely hoping for a cat-like tiger rather than a dog. It seems the possibility of having a child resembling Keel even if the plan failed was also a selling point.

The possibility of a dog like Torao being born was completely disregarded. Is Keel’s bloodline really that strong? That guardian of the crepe tree being Filo-tan’s Rival as an Idol… I won’t accept that!

That said, since Filo-tan and Keel got along well, I don’t dislike Keel. After all, Keel is just the opening act for Filo-tan to shine. With Filo-tan, the eternal angel, and Keel, who’s bound to fade with time, the outcome is a foregone conclusion.

Oh, right—I seem to recall there was a tiny faction rooting for Ren… but you can just ignore such a small group! As for Luna-chan, she belonged to the “spectator faction”—the group that adores Keel no matter who he ends up with.
As expected of Luna-chan, the true embodiment of Filolial. It just goes to show she understands where true love lies. My heart feels cleansed by Luna-chan’s spirit, overflowing with universal love.
